snippet.title: Magnavis | Official Reveal Trailer | WISHLIST NOW
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474070/Magnavis?utm_source=yt-tr

Magnavis is a cooperative first-person 3D horror game for 2–4 players.

Pilot your submarine through narrow, unstable underwater caves where a single mistake can be fatal. Work together to complete assigned missions, repair failing systems, and keep the vessel operational as the environment grows more hostile with every descent.

Communication, coordination, and pressure define survival. The cave does not forgive hesitation. The ocean does not care how prepared you think you are.

This is your first look at Magnavis.
